reasoning_content:
The issue is there are two different conventions being used. Let me fix WorldTick to use the `{ids,chunks}` return type from ObserverEngine, or alternatively I can copy the Object correctly to VPS. Let me re-upload the local WorldTick with the proper imports.

Actually, let me just fix it on the VPS to use chunks property. Let me see if this is a simple fix.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Fix the line to use .chunks
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -i 's/observedChunks.map(c => c.id)/observedChunks.chunks.map(c => c.id)/' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/WorldTick.ts")

# Verify
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep 'observedChunks' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/WorldTick.ts | head -3")
print("Fixed:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
